validity.researcher_notes: Transgaz's national development plan PDSNT 2021–2030 specifies the Romanian counterpart as 'construirea unei conducte de transport gaze naturale in lungime de 146 km ... pe directia Gherăești–Siret', plus a cross-border metering station and compressor amplification at Onești and Gherăești; TYNDP ENTSOG 2020 code TRA-N-596, NSI East Gas, EAST Group 22; total investment 150 million EUR. The edition-over-edition delta is itself evidence the project was being revised, not abandoned: PDSNT 2020–2029 carried 130 km, 2025 and 125 M EUR; PDSNT 2021–2030 carries 146 km, 2026 and 150 M EUR. GEM's 30.00 km on a Khotyn→Siret row is a third figure again.

validity.researcher_notes: NEW EVIDENCE, not a re-litigation of the staged cancelled-review verdict. Transgaz's PDSNT 2021–2030 carries Gherăești–Siret as a LIVE project with an estimated completion year of 2026, an assigned TYNDP code and a budget — against GEM's 'cancelled' with StartYear1 2025. The plan attaches an explicit footnote that the schedule 'depinde de stabilirea parametrilor pentru punctul de interconectare și de graficul de implementare a proiectului de pe teritoriul Ucrainei' — it depends on the Ukrainian-side implementation schedule. So the Romanian side being live is NOT proof the Ukrainian side is: the two readings can both be right, and that is exactly why this is a flag rather than a status change. Whoever resolves it should note the plan's vintage relative to the cancellation date.
